rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Effective MHPSS programming requires close coordination among diverse actors across multiple sectors.25
rows.ne: प्रभावकारी MHPSS कार्यक्रम सञ्चालनका लागि विभिन्न क्षेत्रका विविध सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूबीच घनिष्ठ समन्वय आवश्यक हुन्छ।25
rows.bt: Close coordination among diverse stakeholders from different sectors is necessary to run effective MHPSS programmes.25

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: A multi-sectoral MHPSS coordination mechanism, adequate to the context and number of agencies implementing MHPSS should be established.
rows.ne: सन्दर्भ र MHPSS कार्यान्वयन गर्ने निकायहरूको सङ्ख्याअनुरूप पर्याप्त हुने बहुक्षेत्रीय MHPSS समन्वय संयन्त्र स्थापना गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate to establish a multisectoral MHPSS coordination mechanism that is adequate for the context and the number of agencies implementing MHPSS.
rows.note: The source recommends establishment with 'should'; the back-translation makes establishment mandatory with 'must'. The revision restores recommendation strength.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Especially in larger emergencies where there are multiple MHPSS actors, this should be a single cross-sectoral MHPSS Technical Working Group (MHPSS TWG) which should be established early in the emergency response.
rows.ne: विशेषगरी एकभन्दा बढी MHPSS सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू रहेका ठूला आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा यस्तो संयन्त्र एउटै अन्तरक्षेत्रीय MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) हुनु उचित हुन्छ, जसलाई आपत्कालीन प्रतिकार्यको प्रारम्भिक चरणमा स्थापना गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Especially in large emergencies where there is more than one MHPSS stakeholder, it is appropriate for such a mechanism to be a single intersectoral MHPSS technical working group (MHPSS TWG), which it is appropriate to establish in the early phase of the emergency response.
rows.note: Cross-sectoral recurs in this batch but has no frozen glossary entry; [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] is proposed for review. Both instances of 'should' become 'must'; 'early' becomes 'at the very beginning', and 'multiple' becomes 'many'. The revision restores recommendation strength, early-phase timing and multiplicity without requiring many actors. The cross-sectoral terminology remains pending technical review.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: This group may be co-led by a health and a protection humanitarian organization and/or a governmental organization when feasible.26,27
rows.ne: सम्भव भएमा, स्वास्थ्य क्षेत्रको एक मानवीय संस्था र संरक्षण क्षेत्रको एक मानवीय संस्था र/वा सरकारी संस्थाले यस समूहको संयुक्त नेतृत्व गर्न सक्छन्।26,27
rows.bt: Where possible, one humanitarian organization from the health sector and one humanitarian organization from the protection sector and/or a government institution can jointly lead this group.26,27

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: The MHPSS TWG should promote the coordination of MHPSS activities across both national actors (e.g. CBOs, government) and international actors (e.g. INGOs, UN agencies), provide technical input, and help to ensure consistent standards and quality within MHPSS work.
rows.ne: MHPSS TWG ले राष्ट्रिय सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू (जस्तै CBOs, सरकार) र अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू (जस्तै INGOs, UN निकायहरू) दुवैबीच MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको समन्वय प्रवर्द्धन गर्नु, प्राविधिक योगदान दिनु र MHPSS कार्यमा मापदण्डहरू तथा गुणस्तर एकरूप राख्न मद्दत गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for the MHPSS TWG to promote coordination of MHPSS activities among both national stakeholders (e.g. CBOs, government) and international stakeholders (e.g. INGOs, UN agencies), provide technical input and help keep standards and quality consistent in MHPSS work.
rows.note: The recommendation becomes a mandatory duty in the back-translation. 'Technical input' is also narrowed to technical advice. The revision restores recommendation strength and the broader contribution meaning.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Coordination helps to ensure that the full range of complementary MHPSS activities and services is provided in line with global guidelines.
rows.ne: समन्वयले विश्वव्यापी निर्देशिकाहरूअनुरूप एकअर्काका पूरक सबै प्रकारका MHPSS गतिविधिहरू र सेवाहरू उपलब्ध गराउन मद्दत गर्छ।
rows.bt: Coordination helps provide all types of mutually complementary MHPSS activities and services in accordance with global guidelines.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Poor MHPSS coordination (e.g. separate coordination groups for mental health and for psychosocial support, or linking MHPSS only to one sector or cluster) is associated with ineffective, inefficient, duplicative, inappropriate and potentially harmful programming.
rows.ne: कमजोर MHPSS समन्वय (जस्तै मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक सहयोगका लागि छुट्टाछुट्टै समन्वय समूहहरू हुनु वा MHPSS लाई एउटा क्षेत्र वा क्लस्टरसँग मात्र जोड्नु) प्रभावहीन, स्रोतसाधनको अकुशल उपयोग हुने, दोहोरिने, अनुपयुक्त र सम्भावित रूपमा हानिकारक कार्यक्रम सञ्चालनसँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Weak MHPSS coordination (e.g. having separate coordination groups for mental health and psychosocial support or linking MHPSS to only one sector or cluster) is associated with running programmes that are ineffective, use resources inefficiently, are duplicative, inappropriate and potentially harmful.
rows.note: The wording [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] is reused from the supplied unreviewed T001 and T099 candidates, not introduced as a validated standalone clinical term. General safety draft; review pending.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: 25 The IASC Handbook of MHPSS Coordination aims to establish a consensus-based approach to guiding the work of MHPSS TWGs working at country level. The handbook includes several functions for MHPSS coordination, including 1. (Re)establishing and maintaining a technical working group, 2. Information management, 3. Establishing links between stakeholders, 4. Building capacity, knowledge exchange and peer support, 5. Monitoring and evaluation, 6. Promoting long-term sustainability, 7. MHPSS advocacy.
rows.ne: 25 IASC Handbook of MHPSS Coordination को उद्देश्य देशस्तरमा कार्यरत MHPSS TWGs को कामलाई दिशा दिन सहमतिमा आधारित दृष्टिकोण स्थापित गर्नु हो। यस पुस्तिकामा MHPSS समन्वयका विभिन्न कार्यहरू समावेश छन्: 1. प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह स्थापना वा पुनःस्थापना गर्ने र त्यसलाई कायम राख्ने, 2. सूचना व्यवस्थापन, 3. सरोकारवालाहरूबीच सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्ने, 4. क्षमता विकास, ज्ञान आदानप्रदान र सहकर्मी सहयोग, 5. अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E), 6. दीर्घकालीन दिगोपन प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने, 7. MHPSS का लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 25 The purpose of the IASC Handbook of MHPSS Coordination is to establish a consensus-based approach to guide the work of MHPSS TWGs working at country level. This handbook includes various functions of MHPSS coordination: 1. Establishing or re-establishing and maintaining a technical working group, 2. Information management, 3. Establishing relationships among stakeholders, 4. Capacity development, knowledge exchange and peer support, 5. Monitoring and evaluation (M&E), 6. Promoting long-term sustainability, 7. Advocating for MHPSS.
rows.note: The publication title is retained in English. Information management, capacity building and peer support recur without frozen glossary entries; proposed forms are listed for review.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Facilitate coordination between different actors to avoid duplication, address obstacles and fill gaps in the response based on the MHPSS MSP and relevant assessments.
rows.ne: MHPSS MSP र सान्दर्भिक लेखाजोखाका आधारमा प्रतिकार्यमा दोहोरोपनबाट बच्न, अवरोधहरू सम्बोधन गर्न र अपुग पक्षहरू पूरा गर्न विभिन्न सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूबीच समन्वय सहजीकरण गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Facilitate coordination among different stakeholders to avoid duplication in the response, address barriers and fill gaps based on the MHPSS MSP and relevant assessments.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Facilitate a dialogue between government and humanitarian actors to establish MHPSS-specific roles and responsibilities in the emergency response (e.g. government, INGOs, NGOs, CBOs and other key partners in Health, Protection, Education, Nutrition, CCCM, Shelter and other sectors).
rows.ne: आपत्कालीन प्रतिकार्यमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी विशिष्ट भूमिका र जिम्मेवारीहरू निर्धारण गर्न सरकार र मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूबीच संवाद सहजीकरण गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै स्वास्थ्य, संरक्षण, शिक्षा, पोषण, CCCM, आश्रय र अन्य क्षेत्रहरूमा सरकार, INGOs, NGOs, CBOs र अन्य प्रमुख साझेदारहरू)।
rows.bt: Facilitate dialogue between the government and actors involved in humanitarian work to determine specific roles and responsibilities concerning MHPSS in the emergency response (e.g. government, INGOs, NGOs, CBOs and other key partners in health, protection, education, nutrition, CCCM, shelter and other sectors).

rows.en: Support MHPSS needs assessments and the inclusion of MHPSS in the needs assessments and ongoing monitoring of relevant sectors to inform response planning (e.g. Humanitarian Needs Overviews, Humanitarian and Refugee Response Plans). Maintain a joint depository of existing needs assessments or studies related to the country and/or affected population.
rows.ne: प्रतिकार्यको योजना बनाउन जानकारी उपलब्ध गराउन MHPSS सम्बन्धी आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गर्न तथा सान्दर्भिक क्षेत्रहरूको आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा र नियमित रूपमा भइरहेको अनुगमनमा MHPSS समावेश गर्न सहयोग गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै मानवीय आवश्यकताका समग्र विवरणहरू, मानवीय प्रतिकार्य र शरणार्थी प्रतिकार्यका योजनाहरू)। देश र/वा प्रभावित जनसङ्ख्यासँग सम्बन्धित विद्यमान आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा वा अध्ययनहरूको साझा भण्डार कायम राख्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Support the assessment of MHPSS-related needs and the inclusion of MHPSS in needs assessments and ongoing regular monitoring in relevant sectors to provide information for planning the response (e.g. humanitarian needs overviews, humanitarian response and refugee response plans). Maintain a shared repository of existing needs assessments or studies relating to the country and/or affected population.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Conduct, maintain and distribute a comprehensive mapping of MHPSS actors, services and activities (e.g. 4Ws MHPSS service mapping, MSP Gap Analyses). Review gaps in services at regular intervals to inform planning.
rows.ne: MHPSS सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू, सेवाहरू र गतिविधिहरू सबै समेट्ने नक्साङ्कन गर्नुहोस्, त्यसलाई अद्यावधिक राख्नुहोस् र वितरण गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै 4Ws MHPSS सेवा नक्साङ्कन, MSP Gap Analyses)। योजना बनाउन जानकारी उपलब्ध गराउन सेवाहरूमा अपुग पक्षहरूको नियमित अन्तरालमा समीक्षा गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Conduct mapping that includes all MHPSS stakeholders, services and activities, keep it updated and distribute it (e.g. 4Ws MHPSS service mapping, MSP Gap Analyses). Review gaps in services at regular intervals to provide information for planning.
rows.note: Mapping recurs within this row without a frozen glossary entry; [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] is proposed for review. The identifiers 4Ws and MSP are retained. 'Detailed' does not preserve the coverage requirement in 'comprehensive'. 'MSP Gap Analyses' is recast as analysis of gaps in the MSP itself. The revision restores comprehensive coverage and retains the English technical label without interpreting its scope; that label remains pending technical review.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Regularly share information among humanitarian MHPSS and other actors (e.g. assessment reports, service directories and collated information in designated groups on mhpss.net).
rows.ne: मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न MHPSS सम्बन्धी र अन्य सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूबीच नियमित रूपमा जानकारी आदानप्रदान गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै लेखाजोखा प्रतिवेदनहरू, सेवाहरूका निर्देशिकाहरू र mhpss.net का तोकिएका समूहहरूमा सङ्कलित जानकारी)।
rows.bt: Regularly exchange information among MHPSS-related and other stakeholders involved in humanitarian work (e.g. assessment reports, directories of services and information collected in designated groups on mhpss.net).

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Develop, strengthen, update and implement joint referral pathways (e.g. a directory of services and referral information, common referral forms and pathways, standard operating procedures; SOPs) to facilitate access to the full range of MHPSS services and activities and to additional support as needed (e.g. protection including CP and GBV, health, education, food security and livelihoods, and community-based support). Referral pathways should support a survivor-centred approach and, where a child is concerned, the best interest of the child.
rows.ne: MHPSS का सम्पूर्ण सेवा तथा गतिविधिहरू र आवश्यकताअनुसार थप सहयोगमा पहुँच सहज बनाउन संयुक्त सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू तयार गर्नुहोस्, सुदृढ बनाउनुहोस्, अद्यावधिक गर्नुहोस् र कार्यान्वयन गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै सेवाहरूको निर्देशिका र सेवा प्रेषणसम्बन्धी जानकारी, सेवा प्रेषणका साझा फारामहरू र मार्गहरू, मानक कार्यसञ्चालन प्रक्रियाहरू; SOPs)। थप सहयोगमा, उदाहरणका लागि, CP र GBV सहितको संरक्षण, स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा, खाद्य सुरक्षा तथा जीविकोपार्जन, र समुदायमा आधारित सहयोग पर्छन्। सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरूले हिंसाबाट प्रभावित व्यक्तिलाई केन्द्रमा राख्ने दृष्टिकोणलाई र कुनै बालक वा बालिकासँग सरोकार भएको अवस्थामा सम्बन्धित बालबालिकाको सर्वोत्तम हितलाई समर्थन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Prepare, strengthen, update and implement joint service referral pathways to facilitate access to all MHPSS services and activities and to additional support as needed (for example, a directory of services and information on service referral, shared service referral forms and pathways, standard operating procedures; SOPs). Additional support includes, for example, protection including CP and GBV, health, education, food security and livelihoods, and community-based support. It is appropriate for service referral pathways to support an approach that places the person affected by violence at the centre and, where a boy or girl is concerned, the best interests of the children concerned.
rows.note: The frozen survivor-centred candidate explicitly centres a person affected by violence, whereas the source does not restrict survivors to violence; the recommendation strength and reference to the particular child are retained. bt-divergence: The frozen survivor-centred form specifies a person affected by violence, whereas the source does not restrict survivors to violence. 'Affected' can also include indirectly affected people rather than only people who directly experienced and survived the event. The frozen form is retained.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Coordinate with all relevant sectors, clusters and coordination groups (e.g. Health, Education, CCCM, Shelter, WASH, Nutrition, Protection including AORs (e.g. CP, GBV, Mine Action, Housing, Land and Property (HLP), and the disabilities TWG); with civil society (e.g. CBOs, CSOs); with faith-based actors or spiritual leaders; and with government actors (e.g. ministries of health, social welfare, education). This includes ensuring mutual representation, participation, and contribution at coordination meetings.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Support the development of sustainable mental health, social care, education, livelihoods support and protection systems as part of early recovery planning and during protracted crises. Link MHPSS emergency activities with comprehensive and complementary development activities in coordination with donors and government actors (e.g. supporting long-term planning with government and national actors, workforce development activities, demonstration projects showing system reform across a geographical area).
rows.ne: प्रारम्भिक पुनर्लाभको योजना बनाउँदा र लम्बिँदै गएका सङ्कटको समयमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य, सामाजिक हेरचाह, शिक्षा, जीविकोपार्जन सहयोग र संरक्षणका दिगो प्रणाली विकास गर्न सहयोग गर्नुहोस्। दातृ निकाय र सरकारी सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग समन्वय गरी MHPSS का आपत्कालीन गतिविधिहरूलाई व्यापक र एकअर्काका पूरक विकास गतिविधिहरूसँग जोड्नुहोस् (जस्तै, सरकार र राष्ट्रिय सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग दीर्घकालीन योजना बनाउन सहयोग गर्ने, जनशक्ति विकासका गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने, कुनै भौगोलिक क्षेत्रभरि प्रणाली सुधार देखाउने प्रदर्शन परियोजनाहरू सञ्चालन गर्ने)।
rows.bt: Support the development of sustainable systems for mental health, social care, education, livelihood support and protection when planning early recovery and during prolonged crises. Coordinate with donor agencies and government counterparts to link emergency MHPSS activities with broader and mutually complementary development activities (for example, supporting long-term planning with government and national counterparts, conducting workforce development activities, conducting demonstration projects showing system improvements throughout a geographical area).
rows.note: Recovery refers to humanitarian recovery planning, not clinical recovery.

rows.en: Establish multidisciplinary taskforces to work on urgent context-specific issues that are not being addressed elsewhere (e.g. addressing an upsurge in suicide, MHPSS for older people, MHPSS for children associated with armed forces and groups, perinatal mental health, etc.).

rows.en: Advocate for local and national policies and interventions to reflect international good practice guidelines for MHPSS, and support government actors in designing, implementing or strengthening services.
rows.ne: स्थानीय र राष्ट्रिय नीति तथा हस्तक्षेपहरूमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी असल अभ्यासका अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय निर्देशिकाहरू प्रतिबिम्बित गराउन पैरवी गर्नुहोस् र सेवाहरूको डिजाइन, कार्यान्वयन वा सुदृढीकरण गर्न सरकारी सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूलाई सहयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Advocate for international guidelines on good practice relating to MHPSS to be reflected in local and national policies and interventions, and support government counterparts in designing, implementing or strengthening services.
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical term [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] for advocacy. Interventions here are general policy and service interventions, not a named clinical treatment.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Support the building of national-level capacity for the continuation of coordination by supporting or developing sustainable coordination structures, including government and civil society stakeholders.
rows.ne: सरकार र नागरिक समाजका सरोकारवालाहरूलाई समेत समेट्ने दिगो समन्वय संरचनालाई सहयोग गरेर वा त्यस्ता संरचना विकास गरेर समन्वयलाई निरन्तरता दिन राष्ट्रिय तहको क्षमता विकासमा सहयोग गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Support capacity development at the national level to continue coordination by supporting or developing sustainable coordination structures that also include stakeholders from government and civil society.
rows.note: Proposed recurring nonclinical term: coordination structures = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence]; the frozen glossary is unchanged.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: The Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) MHPSS Reference Group offers technical support, mentoring and training to country-level MHPSS working groups on topics such as establishing an MHPSS TWG, conducting needs assessments, linking with cluster/sectoral groups, conducting situational analysis, referral guidance and service mapping, and M&E. Requests must be inter-agency and can be submitted by email to mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com.
rows.ne: अन्तर-निकाय स्थायी समिति (IASC) को MHPSS सन्दर्भ समूहले देशस्तरीय MHPSS कार्यसमूहहरूलाई MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (TWG) स्थापना गर्ने, आवश्यकताको लेखाजोखा गर्ने, क्लस्टर/क्षेत्रगत समूहहरूसँग सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्ने, परिस्थितिको विश्लेषण गर्ने, सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यसम्बन्धी मार्गदर्शन र सेवाहरूको नक्साङ्कन गर्ने तथा अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) जस्ता विषयमा प्राविधिक सहयोग, मार्गदर्शन (mentoring) र प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध गराउँछ। अनुरोधहरू अन्तरनिकाय हुनुपर्छ र mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com मा इमेलमार्फत पठाउन सकिन्छ।
rows.bt: The MHPSS Reference Group of the Inter-Agency Standing Committee (IASC) provides technical support, mentoring and training to country-level MHPSS working groups on topics such as establishing an MHPSS Technical Working Group (TWG), assessing needs, establishing links with clusters/sectoral groups, analyzing the situation, mapping guidance on referral to relevant services and services, and monitoring and evaluation (M&E). Requests must be inter-agency and can be sent by email to mhpss.refgroup@gmail.com.
rows.note: This is an institutional support description, not a consent or safeguarding declaration. The inter-agency requirement and email address are preserved. Mentoring is reduced to generic guidance in the back-translation. The source term is retained as a qualifier to distinguish this support function; its Nepali technical terminology remains pending review. The back-translation makes referral guidance an object of mapping, whereas the source lists referral guidance and service mapping as distinct support topics.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: Surge support mechanisms increasingly deploy MHPSS experts to support in establishing coordination structures to strengthen MHPSS capacity. Experts are deployed through standby partnerships with UN agencies such as WHO, IOM, UNHCR and UNICEF. The MHPSS surge support mechanism, which is implemented in collaboration with the IASC MHPSS Reference Group, has a specific focus on the deployment of MHPSS experts (contact: mhpss@rvo.nl).
rows.ne: थप सहयोग उपलब्ध गराउने संयन्त्रहरू (surge support mechanisms) ले MHPSS क्षमता सुदृढ गर्न समन्वय संरचना स्थापना गर्ने कार्यमा सहयोग पुर्‍याउन MHPSS विशेषज्ञहरूलाई परिचालन गर्ने क्रम बढ्दो छ। WHO, IOM, UNHCR र UNICEF जस्ता UN निकायहरूसँगका आवश्यक पर्दा परिचालन गर्न तयार राखिने साझेदारीमार्फत विशेषज्ञहरू परिचालन गरिन्छन्। IASC को MHPSS सन्दर्भ समूहसँगको सहकार्यमा कार्यान्वयन गरिने MHPSS surge support mechanism ले विशेष रूपमा MHPSS विशेषज्ञहरूको परिचालनमा ध्यान दिन्छ (सम्पर्क: mhpss@rvo.nl)।
rows.bt: Mechanisms providing additional support (surge support mechanisms) are increasingly deploying MHPSS specialists to help establish coordination structures to strengthen MHPSS capacity. Specialists are deployed through partnerships kept ready for deployment when needed with UN agencies such as WHO, IOM, UNHCR and UNICEF. The MHPSS surge support mechanism implemented in collaboration with the IASC MHPSS Reference Group focuses specifically on the deployment of MHPSS specialists (contact: mhpss@rvo.nl).
rows.note: Uses the proposed term [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] for coordination structures. Surge support mechanisms and standby partnerships are explained as operational arrangements, with the named MHPSS mechanism retained in English. The translation adds an explicit trigger, when needs increase, which the source does not state. That condition is removed. Nepali terminology for surge support mechanisms and standby partnerships remains pending technical review.

rows.en: Key consideration 14: What to do if referral options for mental health services are not accessible?
rows.ne: मुख्य विचारणीय पक्ष 14: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवाका लागि सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यका विकल्पहरू पहुँचयोग्य छैनन् भने के गर्ने?
rows.bt: Key consideration 14: What to do if options for referral to relevant services for mental health services are not accessible?
rows.note: Mental-health service wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity 3.10 candidate. This safety heading remains pending review.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: In a range of humanitarian settings, mental health services may not be available or sufficiently accessible (e.g. due to geographical distance or costs). In these situations, it can be helpful to work with MHPSS TWGs and relevant coordination groups (e.g. health cluster/sector) to:
rows.ne: विभिन्न मानवीय परिस्थितिहरूमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा उपलब्ध नहुन सक्छन् वा पर्याप्त रूपमा पहुँचयोग्य नहुन सक्छन् (जस्तै, भौगोलिक दूरी वा लागतका कारण)। यस्ता अवस्थामा निम्न कार्य गर्न MHPSS TWGs र सान्दर्भिक समन्वय समूहहरूसँग (जस्तै, स्वास्थ्य क्लस्टर/क्षेत्र) मिलेर काम गर्नु उपयोगी हुन सक्छ:
rows.bt: In various humanitarian situations, mental health services may be unavailable or may not be sufficiently accessible (for example, because of geographical distance or cost). In such circumstances, it may be useful to work together with MHPSS TWGs and relevant coordination groups (for example, the health cluster/sector) to do the following:
rows.note: Mental-health service wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity 3.10 candidate; both unavailability and insufficient accessibility are retained.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Work with local actors to identify existing facilities and systems in which to integrate mental health services.
rows.ne: ▶ मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा एकीकृत गर्न सकिने विद्यमान सेवा केन्द्र र प्रणालीहरू पहिचान गर्न स्थानीय सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग मिलेर काम गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: ▶ Work together with local counterparts to identify existing service centres and systems into which mental health services can be integrated.
rows.note: Mental-health service wording reuses the supplied unreviewed activity 3.10 candidate. Facilities are understood as service facilities.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Advocate to government actors and external funders for the needed mobilization of funds and resources to fill service gaps;
rows.ne: ▶ सेवामा रहेका कमी पूरा गर्न आवश्यक रकम तथा स्रोतहरूको परिचालनका लागि सरकारी सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू र बाह्य वित्तीय सहयोगदातासमक्ष पैरवी गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: ▶ Advocate with government stakeholders and external financial donors for the mobilization of the funds and resources needed to fill gaps in services.
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical term [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] for advocacy; government actors and external funders remain distinct. The source calls for mobilization of both funds and resources. The translation instead requests financial support alongside resource mobilization; the revision explicitly applies mobilization to both.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Discuss which actors may be able to support needs in the short-term;
rows.ne: ▶ अल्पकालमा आवश्यकताहरू पूरा गर्न कुन सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सहयोग गर्न सक्षम हुन सक्छन् भन्नेबारे छलफल गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: ▶ Discuss which stakeholders may be able to help meet needs in the short term.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Work with actors to improve access to any existing mental health services, if applicable (e.g. covering financial costs, facilitating transport);
rows.ne: ▶ लागू हुने अवस्थामा, विद्यमान कुनै पनि मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवामा पहुँच सुधार गर्न सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँग काम गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै, आर्थिक खर्च बेहोर्ने, यातायातको व्यवस्था सहज बनाउने)।
rows.bt: ▶ Where applicable, work with stakeholders to improve access to any existing mental health services (e.g., covering financial costs, facilitating transport arrangements).
rows.note: The recurring term 'mental health services' has no dedicated glossary entry. Its Nepali wording reuses the exact phrase [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] supplied in activity candidate T107; this remains an unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: If a coordination group does not exist, one should be established in collaboration with other MHPSS actors (see MSP activity 1.1).
rows.ne: समन्वय समूह नभएमा, अन्य MHPSS सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूसँगको सहकार्यमा त्यस्तो समूह स्थापना गर्नु उचित हुन्छ (MSP गतिविधि 1.1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: If there is no coordination group, it is appropriate to establish such a group in collaboration with other MHPSS stakeholders (see MSP Activity 1.1).
rows.note: The translation strengthens 'should be established' to 'must be established'. The revision restores recommendation rather than mandatory obligation.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: When strengthening existing or establishing new mental health services:
rows.ne: विद्यमान मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा सुदृढ गर्दा वा नयाँ मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा स्थापना गर्दा:
rows.bt: When strengthening an existing mental health service or establishing a new mental health service:
rows.note: The wording [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] is reused from the supplied unreviewed activity candidate T107. A dedicated glossary entry for the recurring term 'mental health services' is proposed.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Aim to shift the locus of care away from psychiatric hospitals towards community-based mental health services. This not only involves strengthening mental health care in primary health care but also making sure that specialized care is accessible through for example, district general hospitals, community mental health teams or community mental health centers. Long-stay psychiatric hospitals should be closed once there are adequate alternatives;
rows.ne: ▶ हेरचाहको केन्द्र मानसिक अस्पतालबाट समुदायमा आधारित मानसिक स्वास्थ्य सेवातर्फ सार्ने लक्ष्य राख्नुहोस्। यसमा प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाहमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाह सुदृढ बनाउने कार्य मात्र होइन, उदाहरणका लागि जिल्लाका सामान्य अस्पतालहरू, समुदायमा आधारित मानसिक स्वास्थ्य टोलीहरू वा समुदायमा आधारित मानसिक स्वास्थ्य केन्द्रहरूमार्फत विशिष्टीकृत हेरचाह पहुँचयोग्य भएको सुनिश्चित गर्ने कार्य पनि पर्छ। पर्याप्त विकल्पहरू उपलब्ध भएपछि लामो अवधिसम्म बसाएर हेरचाह गर्ने मानसिक अस्पतालहरू बन्द गरिनु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ Aim to shift the centre of care from mental hospitals towards community-based mental health services. This includes not only strengthening mental health care in primary health care, but also ensuring that specialized care is accessible, for example through district general hospitals, community-based mental health teams or community-based mental health centres. Once adequate alternatives are available, it is appropriate for mental hospitals that provide care through long-term stays to be closed.
rows.note: The draft retains the aim rather than asserting an achieved shift, includes access to specialized care, and makes recommended hospital closure conditional on adequate alternatives.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Avoid setting up parallel systems if possible and aim to integrate services into existing health and social care systems (e.g. mental health care as part of general health services);
rows.ne: ▶ सम्भव भएमा समानान्तर प्रणालीहरू स्थापना नगर्नुहोस् र सेवाहरूलाई विद्यमान स्वास्थ्य तथा सामाजिक हेरचाह प्रणालीहरूमा एकीकृत गर्ने लक्ष्य राख्नुहोस् (जस्तै सामान्य स्वास्थ्य सेवाको अङ्गका रूपमा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाह)।
rows.bt: ▶ Where possible, do not establish parallel systems and aim to integrate services into existing health and social care systems (for example, mental health care as a part of general health services).
rows.note: The draft preserves the feasibility condition, the aim of integration, and mental health care as part of general health services without replacing care with services.

rows.section: Section 1 > 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.en: ▶ Promote effective collaboration between formal and informal care providers and across different sectors (e.g. referral pathways).
rows.ne: ▶ औपचारिक र अनौपचारिक हेरचाह प्रदायकहरूबीच तथा विभिन्न क्षेत्रहरूबीच प्रभावकारी सहकार्य प्रवर्द्धन गर्नुहोस् (जस्तै, सेवा प्रेषण मार्गहरू)।
rows.bt: ▶ Promote effective collaboration between formal and informal care providers and between different sectors (e.g., service referral pathways).
rows.note: General service-coordination safety guidance drafted for review; no automatic transfer or additional consent procedure is implied.
